tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Pre-trade check for one ERC-20: simulates a buy and a sell on its pool, reads owner powers (mint, pause, blacklist, trading switches) and the deployer's past launches, and answers decision allow, review or block with grade A-F, is_honeypot, tradeable, buy and sell tax and a one-line reason. $0.01 US

tools.name: honeypot_check
tools.description: Simulates a buy and a sell of the token and says whether a holder can sell it, with the measured round-trip loss. $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: token_safety
tools.description: The full evidence report for a token: grade A-F, sell simulation, owner and contract powers, holder concentration, liquidity and deployer history, each finding with its evidence. $0.01 USDC per call via x402.
